function GetGitSoundID(GithubSnd, SoundName)
	SoundName = tostring(SoundName)
	local url = GithubSnd
	local FileName = SoundName
	writefile("customObject_Sound_"..FileName..".mp3", game:HttpGet(url))
	return (getcustomasset or getsynasset)("customObject_Sound_"..FileName..".mp3")
end

function sfx(id, parent, duration, startPosition)
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
	sound.SoundId = id
	sound.Parent = parent
	sound.Volume = 1

	sound:Play()
	sound.TimePosition = startPosition or 0

	task.spawn(function()
		local fadeTime = 3
		local startFadeAt = math.max((duration or sound.TimeLength) - fadeTime, 0)

		task.wait(startFadeAt)

		local startVolume = sound.Volume
		local steps = 30

		for i = 1, steps do
			if not sound.Parent then return end
			sound.Volume = startVolume * (1 - (i / steps))
			task.wait(fadeTime / steps)
		end

		sound.Volume = 0
	end)

	game.Debris:AddItem(sound, duration or 0)
	return sound
end

function getsfxid(id)
	local hi = nil
	if id == "clang" then
		hi = "rbxassetid://495135507"
	elseif id == "yarara" then
		local url = "https://github.com/anhubuniversal-create/Obfuscation-/raw/refs/heads/main/lv_0_20260806181524.mp3"
		hi = GetGitSoundID(url, "Theme")
	end
	return tostring(hi)
end

sfx(getsfxid("yarara"), workspace, 19, 0)
Wait(0.3)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local hrp = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- === CHARACTER PREPARATION ===
local oldAutoRotate = hum.AutoRotate
local oldSit = hum.Sit

-- stop all animations
for _, v in ipairs(hum:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
	v:Stop(0)
end

-- disable physics control
hum.Sit = true
hum.AutoRotate = false
hum.PlatformStand = true

hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

-- ghost mode
local originalCollisions = {}
local function setGhost(state)
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			if state then
				originalCollisions[obj] = obj.CanCollide
				obj.CanCollide = false
				obj.Massless = true
			else
				if originalCollisions[obj] ~= nil then
					obj.CanCollide = originalCollisions[obj]
				end
				obj.Massless = false
			end
		end
	end
end

setGhost(true)

-- animation (optional placeholder)
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://0"
local track = hum:LoadAnimation(animation)
track:Play(1, 5, 1)
track:AdjustSpeed(0.01)

-- checkpoint target
local checkpoint = Instance.new("Part")
checkpoint.Size = hrp.Size
checkpoint.CFrame = hrp.CFrame
checkpoint.Anchored = true
checkpoint.CanCollide = false
checkpoint.Transparency = 1
checkpoint.Parent = workspace

-- transform helper
local origin = frames[1]:Inverse()
local startCFrame = hrp.CFrame

local function getRelative(cf)
	return startCFrame * (origin * cf)
end

-- === MAIN TIMELINE CONFIGURATION ===
local targetFPS = 55        -- Framerate your recorder captured at
local playbackSpeed = 1     -- Change speed here (e.g. 2.0 = 2x speed, 0.5 = half speed)

local totalFrames = #frames
-- Total base duration adjusted by playback speed multiplier
local totalDuration = ((totalFrames - 1) / targetFPS) / playbackSpeed

local function calculateMainTimeline(elapsedTime)
	if elapsedTime >= totalDuration then
		return totalFrames, 1, true
	end
	
	local progress = elapsedTime / totalDuration
	local scaledIndex = progress * (totalFrames - 1) + 1
	local index = math.floor(scaledIndex)
	local alpha = scaledIndex - index
	
	return index, alpha, false
end

-- RUNTIME LOOP
local startTime = tick()
local finished = false
local conn

conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if finished then return end

	local currentTime = tick()
	local elapsedTime = currentTime - startTime
	local index, alpha, isFinished = calculateMainTimeline(elapsedTime)

	if isFinished or index >= totalFrames then
		finished = true
		conn:Disconnect()

		track:Stop()

		-- stabilize before final tween
		hrp.Anchored = true
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

		local tween = TweenService:Create(
			hrp,
			TweenInfo.new(0, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), -- Instant transition (0s)
			{CFrame = checkpoint.CFrame}
		)

		tween:Play()
		tween.Completed:Wait()

		checkpoint:Destroy()

		-- restore state
		hrp.Anchored = false
		setGhost(false)

		hum.PlatformStand = false
		hum.Sit = oldSit
		hum.AutoRotate = oldAutoRotate

		return
	end

	local nextIndex = math.min(index + 1, totalFrames)
	local a = getRelative(frames[index])
	local b = getRelative(frames[nextIndex])

	hrp.CFrame = a:Lerp(b, alpha)
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
	hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)


local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?version=1&id=21633130"

local animationTrack = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)

local fadeTime = 0
animationTrack:Play(fadeTime)
animationTrack.TimePosition = 0
animationTrack:AdjustSpeed(1)

task.delay(11.7, function()
    animationTrack:Stop(fadeTime)
end)
local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

local function playPose(animId, fadeTime, timePos, speed, stopDelay, waitTime)
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?version=1&id=" .. animId
local track = humanoid:LoadAnimation(animation)
track:Play(fadeTime)
track.TimePosition = timePos
track:AdjustSpeed(speed)
task.delay(stopDelay, function()
track:Stop(fadeTime)
end)
if waitTime then
wait(waitTime)
end
end

for i = 1, 11 do
playPose(184573779, 0, 0.5, 0, 1, 1)
playPose(184573748, 0, 0.5, 0, 1, nil)
end
